授業科目の概要.授業科目に関する特筆事項:
(Contrary to what is listed above for "Language of Instruction (Japanese)," this course will be conducted entirely IN ENGLISH.)
This course is divided into two quarters and will challenge students to consider salient global issues through the medium of English. Students will gain confidence in understanding and consequently discussing current affairs, through reading and writing about a wide variety of contemporary topics using English. The course is interdisciplinary in that issues surveyed will include topics in academic tracks such as behavioral science, Earth science, and economics/business. Students will learn strategies for aiding reading comprehension and gain utility with special vocabulary and expressions that are frequently used in online articles and newspapers. Students will also learn various methods of paraphrasing with a goal of writing short summaries of the longer passages used in their reading comprehension practice exercises.  In addition to unassessed homework assignments in the textbook, there will also be assessed online homework assignments, unit tests, and summary assignments of both the homework and in-class variety.

授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）:
By the end of this course (quarter), students will be expected to:
•	Be able to identify main ideas and supporting details of a lengthy reading passage
•	Be able to predict the contents of a text by examining the title, brainstorming, etc.
•	Be able to understand the use of referencing and cohesive devices
•	Be able to infer meaning from details within a reading passage and analyze cause and effect structure
•	Be able to skim a reading passage for important details
•	Be able to paraphrase sentences using a variety of methods
•	Be able to summarize longer reading passages by incorporating paraphrased sentences

授業科目の成績評価の方法について.備考:
ChatGPTなどの生成型・対話型AIの使用についての注意
生成型・対話型と呼ばれるAIは使い方によっては有用ですが、学業での使用には
十分な注意が必要です。そういったAIの生成する答えには一見それらしいけれど
も不正確な情報が多くあります。十分な検証をせずに利用すれば、劣悪な解答や
レポートになってしまいます。また、九州大学では他人の文章をコピーし自分の
ものとすることは、学術不正として厳しく禁止されています。ChatGPT等を単純
利用（コピペ）して作成したレポートは他人の文章をコピーしたものと認定され
ることもあり得ます。特に外国語科目においては、AIの解答を丸写しするだけで
は、何ら学習効果は得られません。
Warning regarding the use of generative/conversational AI such as ChatGPT
Generative/conversational AI is potentially a useful tool in your study but its use in
course work needs special care. Such AI often generates plausible but incorrect
information, which leads to a poor work if you do not critically evaluate AI-generated
texts. Ethically, copying someone else's writing and making it your own is strictly
prohibited as academic misconduct at Kyushu University. A report created by simply
using a tool such as ChatGPT (copying and pasting) may be recognized as copying
someone else's writing. Especially in foreign language courses, you will not learn
anything by copying AI-generated answers.
